projects.name: Sallah bot
projects.description: A Telegram bot written in Python that sends prayer-time reminders based on the user's city, used by about 1,200 people. Deployed on a self-managed Ubuntu server accessed via SSH. Used SQLite to store user preferences, writing tables and queries manually. Identified and fixed a time-zone bug causing late Fajr reminders, adding a check to prevent recurrence.
